subject: Intro request + joint account sprint for CloudScale Health (AWS co-sell)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Williams <ben.williams@amazon.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cloudscalehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28 09:12 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposal: co-sell kickoff and 2-week sprint for CloudScale Health

Hi Ben and Emily —

Following our Slack thread last week, I wanted to connect everyone and propose a short joint account sprint to get CloudScale Health onto the AWS co-sell path. High level ask: get alignment on business outcomes, procurement windows, and a technical checklist so we can qualify for co-sell and position Redwood in the marketplace listing.

Proposed outcomes for the sprint (2 weeks):
- Mutual action plan with owners and dates
- Technical onboarding checklist (SSO, VPC access, data retention controls)
- Go-to-market play: marketplace listing owner and initial joint customer story

Suggested first call: 30–45 minutes to introduce teams, confirm stakeholders, and agree on sprint scope. Availability: Thu Apr 29 10:00–11:30 PT or Fri Apr 30 09:00–11:00 PT.

Ben — can you confirm which AWS partner team members we should include (field seller, partner solutions, partner ops)?
Emily — could you loop in anyone from procurement or security who needs to be on the sprint?

I attached a one-page intake (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx) and a short technical deck.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference

I looped in procurement (procure@cloudscalehealth.com) and our Head of Platform (Jason Lee) on the thread — they requested a short pre-read before the kickoff. Procurement is broadly available Fri Apr 30 09:30–10:30 PT. Security wants the SSO and data retention checklist early in the sprint.

Can we do Fri Apr 30 09:30 PT for the intro? If AWS confirms their availability, that should work for our core stakeholders.
